description: Discreet private driver and personal concierge service in Austin, TX and surrounding areas.
billingNote: Time is billed at $119 per hour with a 30-minute minimum ($59.50). Beyond 30 minutes, time is billed in 15-minute increments. A leftover of 5 minutes or less rounds down; a leftover of more than 5 minutes rounds up to the next 15-minute block. Each leg is computed separately. Examples: 20, 29, 31, or 35 min = $59.50; 36 min bills as 45 min ($89.25); 60 min = $119; a 2 hour 40 minute trip (160 min) bills as 165 minutes ($327.25).

mileageOrigin.name: The Domain, Austin, TX
mileageOrigin.note: Mileage is driving distance from The Domain to the farthest point of the trip (pickup, any stop, or dropoff — whichever is farthest). The first 20 miles are included. Every mile after that is $1.00.

recurringNote: A 15% discount applies when booking a repeating hourly series (for example school runs on selected weekdays). Example: five 30-minute trips are $297.50, less 15% equals $252.88. The repeating discount does not apply to night-out packages.
depositNote: A $50 deposit is required to book. The deposit is arranged by text after you send the request. A booking is confirmed when ZLS texts back.
returnFeeNote: A return or deadhead fee is not currently charged. A customer-requested return trip is quoted as its own leg with the same time and mileage rules and added to the total.
confirmation: A booking is confirmed when ZLS texts back.

howToBook.sms: Text 512.534.1855 with rider name, phone, optional email, pickup, dropoff, stop requests, date and time, passengers, bags, pet or service dog if any, whether there is a return trip, whether the trip repeats, a night-out package if any (6h or 10h), preferred payment method, and the estimate.

deepLinkParams.stops: Free-text stop or special request (for example a coffee run or a second address)
deepLinkParams.date: YYYY-MM-DD (trip date, or series start if recurring)
deepLinkParams.recurring: 1, true, or yes for a repeating series
deepLinkParams.weekdays: MTWRF style (U=Sun, M=Mon, T=Tue, W=Wed, R=Thu, F=Fri, S=Sat) or comma-separated names (mon,tue,wed)
deepLinkParams.name: Customer name
deepLinkParams.prefs: Optional "Your perfect ride" preferences: favorite snack, music, chat level
deepLinkParams.return: 1, true, or yes to include a return trip
deepLinkParams.returnPickup: Return pickup address (defaults to the outbound dropoff)
deepLinkParams.returnDropoff: Return dropoff address (defaults to the original pickup)
deepLinkParams.pay: Preferred payment method: zelle, cashapp, venmo, applepay, taptopay, or cash
deepLinkParams.pet: 1, true, or yes if a pet or service dog is coming
deepLinkParams.package: Night-out / DD package: 6h or 10h. Omit or leave empty for hourly.

6-hour night out, 175 miles from The Domain

returnTripNote: If a return trip is requested, it is priced as a separate leg (same time-billing rules, plus $1 per mile beyond 20 miles from The Domain to the farthest point of that leg) and added to the total. Recurring series include the return on each occurrence before the 15% discount.
paymentNote: Cash is paid at pickup. Tap to Pay, Apple Pay, Zelle, Cash App, and Venmo can be paid during the trip. A $50 deposit is arranged by text after you send the request. Payment handles are provided by text when needed.
packageNote: Night-out / designated-driver packages are flat blocks for a party of up to 4: $600 for 6 hours, $950 for 10 hours. packagesIncludeMileage is false, meaning the flat price does not include mileage — $1 per mile beyond 20 miles from The Domain still applies. The 15% recurring discount does not apply to packages.

riderPolicy.noShow: No-shows forfeit the $50 deposit. After one no-show, future bookings require the full fare paid in advance as a nonrefundable deposit. A second no-show results in a permanent ban from service.
